# Feature: Rich Document Renderer & `ask` Cutover

## 1. Feature Goal

**ID**: FEAT-015
**Source Plan**: `.spec-lite/plan_v2.md` (row FEAT-015; §3 rendering toolchain additions; §5 `ask` flags + Brief Shape; §7 "Renderer holds zero business logic" + strangler-fig cutover; §8 renderer dependency override; §9 renderer snapshot tests)

Give the Brief a presentation worthy of it: a **`BriefRenderer`** that turns a fully-formed `Brief` into (1) styled terminal output — boxed overview, scannable key findings, real aligned comparison tables, numbered sources — with progressive disclosure via `--detail {overview|standard|full}`; (2) a portable `brief.md`; (3) a self-contained, inert, themed `brief.html`. `--json` remains a parallel, dependency-free path that emits the Brief verbatim.

This feature also executes the plan's **strangler-fig cutover**: `yantra ask` switches from the card pipeline to `Search → Fetch → Extract → Synthesize → Render`, and the legacy path — `packages/core/src/extraction/card.ts`, the `AskCard` type, `summarizer.ts`, `llm-summarizer.ts`, and the per-source card assembly inside `ask-pipeline.ts` — is **deleted in the same change** (pre-release, no backward compat, per memory §General "remove legacy cleanly"). The MVP's "no decoration deps" minimalism is deliberately reversed for the renderer only (plan §8 override): `marked` + `marked-terminal`, `cli-table3`, `chalk`, `boxen` are adopted; the `--json` path must never import them (enforced by check).

## 2. Data Model (Granular)

> No new persistent entities — this feature consumes FEAT-013's `Brief` and produces artifacts. Granular model = artifact layout + renderer options.

### Entities & Attributes

- **BriefArtifacts** (on-disk, per run — extends the existing `runs/<run-id>/` layout from memory §Project Structure):
  - `brief.json` — canonical Brief document (schema-validated before write). Replaces `outputs.json`'s `{ cards }` payload for ask runs.
  - `brief.md` — full-document portable Markdown (always full detail, independent of `--detail`).
  - `brief.html` — self-contained themed HTML (inlined CSS, escaped content, zero JS, no remote loads).
- **RenderOptions** (in-memory, `apps/cli`):
  - `detail` (`'overview' | 'standard' | 'full'`, default `standard`) — terminal disclosure level only; artifacts always full.
  - `format` (`'terminal' | 'md' | 'html' | 'json'`, default `terminal`) — what goes to stdout.
  - `noColor` (boolean — from `--no-color`/`NO_COLOR`/non-TTY, existing convention), `width` (number — TTY columns, clamped 60–120).
  - `open` (boolean) — open `brief.html` via OS default browser after render.
- **Detail-level contract** (terminal): `overview` = title + overview box + sources; `standard` = + key findings + facet tables + notices; `full` = + sections + per-source lines. `--json` ignores detail (whole document, byte-stable).

### Relationships

- Brief 1:1 each artifact; artifacts derived, never edited (regenerable from `brief.json`).
- `RunStore` gains awareness of `brief.json` for `yantra show <run-id>` / `report` integration.

### Indexes & Constraints

- Markdown/HTML generation is **pure** (`Brief → string`) — no I/O, no clock, no randomness → snapshot-safe.
- HTML inertness: all source-derived strings HTML-escaped; CSP-equivalent by construction (no `<script>`, no external `href`/`src` except source hyperlinks with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`); plan §6 "HTML artifact is inert".
- Import restriction: `apps/cli/src/render/json.ts` and any `--json` code path must not import `marked*`, `cli-table3`, `chalk`, `boxen` (plan §8) — enforced by lint/static check.

## 3. Files

- `packages/core/src/brief/to-markdown.ts` — pure `briefToMarkdown(brief): string` (needs no rendering deps — hand-assembled Markdown).
- `packages/core/src/brief/to-html.ts` — `briefToHtml(brief): string` via `marked` + inlined CSS theme + escaping.
- `packages/core/src/brief/write-artifacts.ts` — atomic write of `brief.json`/`brief.md`/`brief.html` into the run dir (`.tmp` + rename, matching `FilesystemCheckpointStore` convention).
- `apps/cli/src/render/brief-terminal.ts` — ANSI renderer (`marked-terminal`, `cli-table3`, `chalk`, `boxen`), detail levels, width handling, `noColor` degradation.
- `apps/cli/src/render/types.ts` — extend `OutputRenderer`/`ConnectorResult` with a `brief` result kind (folds the ad-hoc card path into the unified renderer per plan §7).
- `apps/cli/src/render/terminal.ts`, `json.ts` — dispatch the new `brief` kind (json.ts prints the Brief verbatim, zero new imports).
- `apps/cli/src/commands/ask.ts` — cutover: new flags (`--detail`, `--format`, `--open`, `--length`), Brief pipeline wiring, exit codes unchanged.
- `packages/core/src/extraction/ask-pipeline.ts` — refactored: search/fetch/extract loop feeds `Synthesizer`; card assembly, `noticeCard()`, `makeQuotedSnippet()` removed.
- **Deleted**: `packages/core/src/extraction/card.ts`, `summarizer.ts`, `llm-summarizer.ts`; `AskCard` + card-only types from `extraction/types.ts`; card branches in `apps/cli/src/commands/ask.ts` and `ask.spec.ts`.
- `apps/cli/tests` / `packages/core/tests/brief/` — snapshot + unit suites; `e2e/ask.spec.ts`, `e2e/ask-no-llm.spec.ts` — updated for Brief output.
- `scripts/ci-static-check.ts` — new import-restriction rule for the `--json` path.

## 4. Dependencies

- **FEAT-013** (Brief schema) and **FEAT-014** (Synthesizer produces the Brief `ask` renders) — hard; this is the tail of the strictly-sequential Phase 0 chain.
- New packages (latest stable; check with user before pinning, per memory §Dependencies): `marked`, `marked-terminal`, `cli-table3`, `chalk`, `boxen`.
- FEAT-016 is _not_ required — `ask` keeps using the current provider selection until the registry lands.

## 6. Cross-Cutting Concerns

- **Auth**: N/A — rendering only.
- **Error Handling**: renderer never throws on a valid Brief (total functions over the schema); artifact-write failures are `Result` errors surfaced as run-level warnings (run still succeeds with terminal output — artifacts are best-effort); `--open` failure is a warning, never an exit-code change.
- **Logging**: artifact paths logged at info in `events.jsonl` run manifest; no Brief content in logs (it's already the artifact).
- **Security**: HTML inertness (TASK-003 property test); no ANSI in artifacts/`--json` (schema + tests); `--json` path dependency-freedom enforced by static check (TASK-001).
